description: This file defines the interface 'ReportMailingJobWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting report mailing jobs within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobWritePlatformService
classes.description: A service interface for managing report mailing jobs, including creation, update, and deletion operations.

methods.name: createReportMailingJob
methods.description: Creates a new report mailing job based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateReportMailingJob
methods.description: Updates an existing report mailing job identified by its ID with new details from the JSON command.

methods.name: deleteReportMailingJob
methods.description: Deletes an existing report mailing job specified by its ID.
